response.original_title: ((Connecting_Rooms)) How to get connecting rooms on Saga Cruise
response.overview: To book connecting rooms on Saga Cruise, call Saga directly at +1-866-829-1280 or use a certified travel agent. The Saga website only allows booking one stateroom at a time, making it nearly impossible to guarantee adjoining doors without speaking to a booking agent who can access the full cabin inventory. Do not attempt to book two separate rooms on the website and hope they are side-by-side. Call Saga customer service directly +1-866-829-1280 or use a travel agent so they can view the ship's layout and lock in two specific, connecting cabins at the same time.
